title: Formulas, Proportions, Percents and Word Problems | Algebra I, Unit 2, Part 2 (with Worked Examples)
description:
Learn to solve linear equations from the ground up. Start with the balance idea and inverse operations for one-step equations, undo operations in reverse order for two-step equations, then use a four-step plan for multi-step equations with distributing and variables on both sides. Finish with equations that have no solution or infinitely many solutions. After every lesson there's a step-by-step worked example with tips and a practice question, and the unit ends with a real-world "Putting it together" problem.
